requirements.text: After reset, remain in INITIALIZING until initialization, input validity, link availability, and command-channel authentication permit operation.
In NOMINAL, prefer the primary communication link and permit mission progression.
When the primary link is unavailable and the secondary link remains available, select the secondary link.
Enter DEGRADED when link quality is degraded, either link is unavailable, or command-channel authentication is lost.
Enter LOST_LINK when link loss persists or both communication links are unavailable.
Command permission shall require an authenticated command channel and at least one available communication link.
LOST_LINK shall request the declared lost-link procedure and return-to-home action in the same logical cycle.
DEGRADED, LOST_LINK, and LOCKOUT shall not transition directly to NOMINAL.
Recovery shall pass through RECOVERY_PENDING after stable communication conditions are observed.
Return to NOMINAL shall require stable recovery and an authorized reset.
Invalid or stale required inputs shall invoke the conservative communication-output policy.
A blocking runtime fault shall inhibit normal commit and invoke the declared communication fault policy.
State transitions and latched link faults shall produce bounded diagnostic identities.
A LOST_LINK or LOCKOUT state shall latch the blocking communication fault until declared recovery conditions clear it.
Every output shall receive an unconditional deterministic default before conditional output logic.
Every supported executable statement shall be represented in AIR and executable by the reference interpreter and generated backend.
Identical controlled source, tool version, and configuration shall produce byte-identical authoritative artifacts.
